subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: What first-class Projects MVP should OpenClaw core support, and should project-scoped tool, skill, workspace, and runtime constraints be display-only warnings or enforceable policy?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but it defines durable product, protocol, storage, session-state, and security contracts that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Core Project Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify the Project storage model, `projects.*` RPCs, UI workflow, and warn-only versus enforced constraint semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Session Organization
options.body: Limit near-term work to session categories, pinned sessions, home-session links, and workspace links without a broad Project domain model or runtime enforcement.

options.title: Defer To External Surface
options.body: Keep using existing sessions, agents, worktrees, skill allowlists, and sandbox settings while community prototypes stay outside core until a smaller API gap is proven.

recommendation.title: Define Core Project Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify the Project storage model, `projects.*` RPCs, UI workflow, and warn-only versus enforced constraint semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided the prior keep-open routing signal and recently worked on adjacent Gateway workspace and sidebar/session surfaces.
